paragraphs: Amadeus sells technology to airports, covering the passenger experience from check-in through departure. On the operations side it offers modular products for turnaround planning and execution. Baggage work is a third strand, with automated bag tracking and messaging.

A self-service bag drop product, the Series 7, is described as chosen by top airports to process millions of bags. Another product, the Airport Companion App, handles disruption handling, ancillary services, payments, and document checks. It runs on a tablet, which lets agents serve travelers anywhere in the terminal without fixed infrastructure. A separate showcase site collects the full portfolio for airports, airlines, and border authorities in one place.

The company says its technology has powered the global travel and tourism industry for over 35 years. It states that airports of all sizes partner with it for flexible solutions and for help with sustainable airport development. A customer story features John F Kennedy International Air Terminal, which services 21 airlines and between 70,000 and 90,000 passengers a day.

quote.text: Airports of all sizes choose to partner with Amadeus for our flexible solutions, our assistance in sustainable airport development
